description: This source file defines the ApiTokenHelper class which provides static methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users for testing purposes.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A utility class for creating JWT tokens with specific user claims for testing API authentication.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Returns a JWT token string representing an admin user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Returns a JWT token string representing a normal user.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with the specified username and roles.
